summary: Adds Q.__rand__ mirroring __and__, making Q() & Exists(...) commutative with Exists(...) & Q(). Minimal, correct, matches Django's actual accepted fix for this ticket.

issues.description: Only __rand__ added; __ror__ not addressed. Issue text mentions '(and |)' but the reproduction and accepted fix scope only __and__/&. Not blocking since | works differently and was not part of the failing repro.
